title: OpenDPI Connection
description: A connection to an infrastructure endpoint where data resides. May be defined inline or as a $ref to an external connection file.

type.description: The type identifier. This is a user-defined string that identifies the type of infrastructure (e.g., kafka, s3, postgresql, http, grpc).

host.description: The addressable host, broker list, or base URL.

description.description: A human-readable description of this connection.

variables.description: Type-specific configuration as key-value pairs. The keys and values depend on the type.

$ref.description: Relative or absolute file path to an external connection definition (YAML or JSON). The referenced file must itself match the inline connection shape.
